Farmer Dies After Alleged Harassment Over Drug Complaint

A farmer has died after consuming poison, with his family alleging he faced harassment following a complaint about 'chitta' (heroin) to a Punjab minister. The incident occurred after the farmer had raised an issue regarding the sale of the drug. The family claims the man was pressured after lodging the complaint. The Statesman and The Tribune reported the incident, highlighting the family's allegations of harassment and pressure.
